$comment: The hub's own room sensor add-on (issue #86, firmware_sensor/): an ESP32 with a temperature/humidity sensor (SHT3x, AHT20, SHT21/HTU21/Si7021) on a short cable. Set up and paired exactly like the IR blaster (adapters/addon.rs): a new one gets the WiFi over Bluetooth, protected by the code on its label; one already on the WiFi is found by mDNS and paired with the same code. Format: wiki Device-Templates.
name: Room sensor
description: The hub's own temperature and humidity sensor module: an ESP32 with a small sensor on a cable, placed where the room's air is. New readings every minute.

inputs.label: Sensor address
inputs.hint: The sensor's console shows it: type `status`, e.g. 192.168.1.150

inputs.label: Pairing code
inputs.hint: On the sensor's label, or type `pairing` in its console: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX (small letters are fine)

inputs.label: WiFi name
inputs.hint: The network the sensor joins (2.4 GHz). The hub's own network is filled in.

inputs.label: WiFi password
inputs.hint: Leave empty for an open network. Only sent to the sensor, not kept on the hub.

steps.text: Plug the new room sensor in, within a few metres of the hub. It waits for setup over Bluetooth: new, or after holding its BOOT button for 5 seconds.

steps.hint: Setting up the sensor: WiFi over Bluetooth, then pairing. This takes up to a minute.

setup.label: Already on the WiFi: find it

steps.text: Plug the room sensor in where it will stay, and make sure it's on the WiFi.
